02 / About Ola

Curiosity.
Craft.
Connection.

Sohra Culture & Experience Centre / Gallery study

Ola Magdy
Principal Associate Designer
Archohm

Ola Magdy is an architect working across buildings, landscapes and cities. Her approach brings together the study of place, physical making and the everyday experience of architecture.

As Principal Associate Designer at Archohm, she works across cultural, healthcare, residential and public-realm projects. Her professional experience spans Egypt and India, and this portfolio documents her work in Meghalaya, Bihar and Bodoland.

Physical model-making remains a valued part of her design process. Site visits, conversations with project stakeholders and the study of buildings through travel continue to shape her understanding of space, light, materials and the people who inhabit them.

From a small intervention beside a river to a wider vision for a city, this collection follows the work from early studies to architectural drawings and visualisations.

Practice & collaboration

Projects shown were developed at Archohm. Individual pages document design proposals, development studies and alternative schemes.
